_why: Campaigns replace one-change-per-iteration aiming. Eight iterations produced +0.6 capability because every turn targeted whatever gated the benchmark — which is always Accurate Communication, the SMALLEST remaining gap (16.3 of 360). The other 340 points are absent features: Self Follow-Up (+48), Self-Pruning (+51), Learn (+43). A feature cannot be built by a 20-minute turn aimed at a criterion, so a capability now gets a multi-iteration budget and the loop is told to stay on it.
_rules: The campaign sets the TARGET; Codex still reviews every turn and its directive governs HOW, not WHAT. A campaign ends when its exit condition is met or its budget is spent — whichever first — and the orchestrator records which. Never silently extended.

active.name: Self Follow-Up
active.target: 43 → 65 (Self Follow-Up), with each increment deployed as it lands
active.goal: Brain chases its own commitments unprompted: a delegated item whose deadline passes produces a chase without being asked, and a chase that gets no reply escalates. CL-033 evidence: the owner had to say 'chase her' three times and got 'I've made a note of that'.
active.exit_condition: Increments 1 and 3 OBSERVED LIVE on the owner's WhatsApp with the messages quoted back to him. Grok's score is recorded but is not the exit condition — the owner ruled improvement must be real, not numeric.
active.why_this_one: Largest gain reachable without a new instrument: +22 capability points = +2.44 overall, which is 3x everything 18 iterations have produced. Grok can score it from code — 'does a passed deadline produce a chase' is answerable by reading the scheduler — so it does not depend on C-1's unfinished slice.
active.the_capability_in_the_owner's_words: R-1, 2026-08-12: he said 'chase her' and got 'I've made a note of that'. Then said it again. Then asked 'What did u got from my word chase her again?'. A professional assistant chases without being asked at all.

increments.title: The chase is stored and visible — folded into increment 1, not a turn of its own
increments.what: Persist body, recipient and send time for every worker-sent chase. NOT a standalone iteration: it is plumbing, worth ~0 capability points on its own, and spending a whole turn on it is how a campaign spends its budget without moving anything.
increments.done_when: Shipped WITH increment 1, in the same deploy.
increments.capability_points: 0 alone — it is what makes 1-3 observable

increments.title: A due commitment produces a chase, unprompted
increments.what: The delegatee follow-up worker actually reaches the delegatee. Today 43 of 76 follow-ups go to the OWNER as a brain_prompt instead, and no WhatsApp chase has a provider receipt (D-12).
increments.done_when: A real chase reaches Hamna without the owner asking, quoted verbatim with its send time, from production.
increments.capability_points: +10 to +15 on Self Follow-Up — this is the capability, not a repair of it

increments.title: An unanswered chase escalates with the elapsed time
increments.what: Survives a pm2 restart — a durable schedule, not an in-memory timer.
increments.done_when: He receives a real escalation naming the elapsed hours, after a restart.

increments.title: 'chase her' is EXECUTED, not noted
increments.what: His exact R-1 failure: he said it three times and got 'I've made a note of that'.
increments.done_when: He types it on live WhatsApp and a real message reaches Hamna in that turn.

active.scope_rule: ONE COHERENT CAPABILITY INCREMENT PER TURN, not one coherent change. Attribution is the campaign; a feature needs several files and the one-change rule was blocking that. Codex still reviews every turn and remediation still applies.
active.deploy_rule: Every increment that clears the gate SHIPS the same iteration. Undeployed work is worth zero under the owner's rubric, so an unshipped increment has not moved the capability.
active.abort_condition: If after 4 iterations Grok has not moved Self Follow-Up by at least +5, stop and report to the owner rather than spending the remaining budget. C-1 ran seven iterations for +0; that must not repeat.
active.owner_ruling_2026_08_13: 'improvement should not be in numbers it should be in real'. So an increment is NOT done when Grok scores it, and NOT done when tests pass. It is done when the behaviour is OBSERVED ON HIS LIVE WHATSAPP and the evidence is quoted back to him. The capability score follows the reality; it never substitutes for it.
active.reporting_rule: Report to the owner in behaviour, not metrics. Lead with what Brain now does that it did not do before, quoting the real message. The capability delta goes last, as corroboration.
active._increment_0_added: 2026-08-13 — inserted after measuring that no table retains a worker-sent body. Increments 1-4 keep their numbers and their order.
active._rewritten_2026_08_13: Owner: 'i have very serious concern with such progress in decimals'. He is right, and the arithmetic backs him: iterations 21+22 netted 0.0, and even a FULLY delivered version of this campaign as originally written was +2.4 overall across 8 iterations — 0.31 per iteration, which needs 131 iterations to reach 87.3. The plan was inadequate, not just its execution. Rewritten so every increment SHIPS and every increment is something he receives, because capability scores are step functions: they move when a capability starts EXISTING, not when an existing one is repaired.
active.success_measure: He receives a real chase, unprompted, and can quote it back. Grok credits the capability only on deployed, production-observed behaviour — never on a passing test.
active.after_this_campaign: ABSENT capabilities, in the priority order of capability_targets.md: Self-Pruning 33, Simple & Smart 33, Thinking 36 — 44.3% of the remaining journey between them, and scored 'absent' by Grok, meaning nothing implements them. A single campaign that makes one of them EXIST is worth +3 to +4 overall, which is more than the last 22 iterations produced together.
active.what_stops_being_a_source_of_work: The benchmark fixQueue. Owner ruling: capabilities drive, benchmark guards. Five of the last five iterations were still chosen by the reviewer's findings on one conversational case, which is why the movement was in decimals. The reviewer still gates QUALITY; it no longer chooses WHAT.

queued.name: Self-Pruning
queued.goal: Junk withdraws itself without being asked. The backlog pruner exists (DEF-132) and is unmeasured; CL-033 shows ten unactionable pushes from one unknown number in a single morning.
queued.exit_condition: Grok scores Self-Pruning >= 55, and a duplicate-sender burst produces at most one grounded digest.

history.name: Measurement surfaces (D-5)
history.goal: Make the seven unmeasurable capabilities scorable. Proactive slice first (the surface that produced 14 of 19 messages in CL-033), then memory recall, then self follow-up. Each small (2-3 cases) but through the REAL path; reported SEPARATELY from the twelve compose cases; existing cases, judge and gate untouched.
history.exit_condition: At least the proactive slice runs end-to-end and reports its own score separately, with D-1 teardown in place so it does not write the owner's live backlog.
history.why_first: Building a capability before it can be measured scores 0 and reads as failure — which is exactly what happened to iterations 3, 5, 6 and 9. The instrument comes first or the next campaign is invisible too.

extended.reason: Budget spent at iteration 14 with NEITHER half of the exit condition met. (1) Codex ruled the slice measures selected text functions under synthetic inputs, not end-to-end real producers. (2) D-1 teardown is absent — the benchmark has written to the owner's live tenant on all 14 runs. Extended rather than closed because C-2 (Self Follow-Up) cannot be scored without an end-to-end proactive measure, so abandoning C-1 half-built would make the next campaign invisible exactly as iterations 3/5/6/9 were. Recorded here because my own rule says a campaign is never silently extended, and iteration 15 had already begun under a spent budget before I noticed.
extended.cost_note: Iterations 13 and 14 were consumed by a data-loss regression and its fix rather than by the campaign goal — the extension buys back that ground, it does not add scope.

exit_condition_status.end_to_end: NOT MET — Codex, iteration 12: synthetic inputs
exit_condition_status.d1_teardown: NOT MET — 14 runs wrote live data

deliverables.blocks: the whole campaign — 15 runs have now written live data, and D-4 (sampling) multiplies it

history.this_iteration_ranks_first: REMEDIATION FIRST (the loop enforces it): iteration 16 closed WEAK, so iteration 17 finishes DEF-159 — both reviewers named the same residual, one typed identity object shared by routing and display. That clears D-9's S3 AND S1: the owner sees names instead of numbers, and it is now DEPLOYED so it counts. THEN C1-D1 (the benchmark's live-tenant writes, 17 runs) — it blocks this campaign's exit, which blocks C-2 Self Follow-Up (+48.2), the largest measurable gain available. C1-D2 (end-to-end slice) after that.
history.orchestrator_note: Drift diagnosis, 2026-08-13, mine not the Builder's: the campaign block set a GOAL and left Codex's directive governing the turn. Each iteration the Builder honestly declared it was following Codex — and each time that was a defect, not the exit condition. Iterations 12 (slice, synthetic), 13 (regression), 14 (its fix), 15 (adjacent durable record). Naming deliverables and ranking them explicitly for the final iteration is the fix; if it still drifts, the campaign mechanism is wrong rather than under-specified.

closed.outcome: BUDGET SPENT, EXIT CONDITION NOT MET
closed.detail: Seven iterations (12-18) against a three-iteration original budget, extended once to five. Neither half of the exit condition met: the proactive slice measures selected text functions under synthetic inputs (Codex, iteration 12) and D-1 teardown is absent after 18 runs that wrote the owner's live backlog. What it DID produce: nexeoProactiveBenchmark.ts (a separate, separately-reported surface), proactiveMessageText.ts, and six defects — DEF-155..159, 162-164 — several of them repairs of its own regressions.
closed.why_closed_not_extended: Extending a third time would be the drift this file exists to stop. The honest reading is that instrument-building consumed the campaign: iterations 13/14 were a data-loss regression and its fix, 15 was WRONG, 16-18 were remediation. Owner, 2026-08-13: 'this progress makes many months to get target' — he is right, and the cause is the unit of work, not the governance.
closed.lesson: A campaign whose deliverable is an INSTRUMENT has no capability target, so nothing tells it when to stop. Every campaign from here targets a capability by number.

_ranking_note: Queued campaigns are ordered by GAP SIZE, not by convenience. Owner, 2026-08-13: 'i need significant improvement in each iteration' — so the loop works the largest measurable gap available. Self-Pruning (+51.5), Self Follow-Up (+48.2) and Learn (+43.5) dwarf Accurate Communication's remaining 15.3, which has already absorbed eight iterations.
